The Susona Bodrum resort is an excellent location for a destination wedding & visit to nearby Bodrum city & harbor. The bride chose one of the Susona's docks into the bay of the Aegean for the ceremony's location, and one of several indoor/outdoor large meeting spaces for the preliminary reception & post-ceremony dinner. All these spaces were large enough for up to ~150 guests. The service from the staff was excellent, particularly when one of Bodrum's frequent passing evening showers came by shortly after the wedding ceremony had concluded. The helpful staff quickly deployed umbrellas & towels to get everyone under cover and to get all the seats dried out after the shower passed. The staff was always helpful during our entire stay @ Susona, even with so many wedding guests trying to arrange things at last minute. The food @ Susona was very good, both during the wedding & during the daily breakfast service. The pool waitstaff was equally good; bringing us custom orders poolside and to the small seating area. There are two conventional pools (both with reasonably warm water, even in mid-May) and you can swim in the Aegean if you like (you're on your own with the ocean water temperature). Our rooms are very nice; with the size & comfort you'd expect in a destination resort. Note the building holding the rooms are some distance from the main lobby, breakfast & pool area. You'll have to walk to these, or call for one of the golf/utility carts to come to pick you (and your luggage) up. Private cars won't be allowed near the room past the main parking area. My room towards the back was very quiet while I was there, although during the wedding party we were the ones making all the noise. Occasionally you'll hear one of the many resident cats meow in anticipation of another food treat; give them any and you'll have a companion for the remainder of your stay. Susona is pretty isolated from the rest of its neighbors; they assume you'll be spending much of your time on site. There's nothing really to walk to nearby. A taxi ride to downtown Bodrum is ~$15 each way. I'd recommend this for a destination event, such as a wedding, or you want to get away for any downtown hustle.
